title: 最长连续序列
statement: 给定一个未排序的整数数组 nums，找出其中数值连续（相邻两数相差 1）的最长序列的长度。序列元素不要求在原数组中相邻，重复值只算一次。空数组返回 0。

en.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
en.statement: Given an unsorted integer array nums, find the length of the longest sequence of consecutive values (adjacent numbers differ by 1). The elements need not be adjacent in the original array, and duplicate values count only once. Return 0 for an empty array.

complexity.officialRequirement: Official requirement: design an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.
complexity.notes: n is the array length. Put all numbers in a hash set and count forward only from starting points where x-1 is not in the set, so each number is visited a constant number of times; hashing is O(1) on average. Sorting is O(n log n): it gives correct results but does not meet the official requirement, and local tests cannot tell the difference. The largest local test has 30000 elements (the official limit is 100000, reduced to keep the problem bank small).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n integers (an empty line when n is 0). stdout: one integer, the length of the longest consecutive sequence.

complexity.time: O(n) 平均时间（官方要求）
complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（哈希集合）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方要求设计 O(n) 时间复杂度的算法。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。把所有数放进哈希集合，只从「x-1 不在集合中」的起点向后数，每个数最多被访问常数次；哈希为平均 O(1)。排序做法为 O(n log n)，结果正确但不满足官方要求，本地测试无法区分。本地最大测试为 30000 个元素（官方上限 100000，为控制题库体积而缩小）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数（n 为 0 时为空行）。stdout：一个整数，最长连续序列的长度。
